integrity: All-parameter proof based on explicit matroid identification, augmented relative chains and matroid shellability; finite computational corroboration separately recorded. Publication priority not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Nonempty proper roots, complete bipartite graphs with shores of size at least two and 1 <= r < number of unrooted vertices. No integral splitting of the equivariant exact sequence is claimed; no statement for arbitrary graphs or empty roots.
title: Relative co-connected complexes of complete bipartite graphs: matroid structure, homotopy and symmetry
